articleHeadline: High intragenotypic diversity, serogroup heterogeneity, and recombination of African swine fever virus strains circulating in sylvatic and domestic hosts
articleSummary: High intragenotypic diversity, serogroup heterogeneity, and recombination of African swine fever virus (ASFV) strains circulating in sylvatic and domestic hosts in Zambia.
